items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1959-08-11
items.q: There were two men in the band. Snow and this other fella, Charlie Washington.

ctx.x: No, he wasn't too loud, but he could play good though. Yeah. And... Well, then they used... At Tom Anderson, they used two guitars, you see. Because they had more vocal. The fellas... There were two men in the band. Snow and this other fella, Charlie Washington. Them two fellas could sing. And this other fella, Tom Brown, who played the mandolin. He could play mandolin by note. But he read music. Yeah. Well, he was the leader. And then I played bass, you know. I'd taken Sam Orange's place on the bass. And I…
